Name: Winter new Crops - Mystical Mushrooms
Author: lunightmare
Description:
I got lots of plans for modding crops for Stardew Valley, but since we don't have winter crops, thought I'd start by making some!
Three new crops, all of them magical mushrooms, that shine a little bit.
[b][u]They are ONLY for winter![/u][/b]

[b][size=3]!! Download Spacecore to make the mod work, since the three crops are made for winter![/size]


[size=5][i]DOWNLOAD INSTRUCTIONS

[/i][/size][size=3]· Download the mod in "Files".[/size]
[b][size=3]· Once downloaded, extract de zip file, it has a folder inside with the name of the mod.
[b][size=3]· Place it in your "Mods" folder, located in your Stardew Valley folder.[/size][/b][/size]
[/b][b][size=3]· Run your game through SMAPI.
[/size][b][size=3]· Have fun![/size][/b]
[/b][/b]

[i][b][size=4][u]By:  ~ Luna ~[/u][/size][/b][/i]
